---
title: Custom Scalarization
jupyter: python3
---


A `SoboStrategy` combines several objectives into the single value it maximizes by its `scalarization`. Besides the built-in ones (`WeightedSumScalarization`, `WeightedProductScalarization`, `WeightedProductSumScalarization`), you can register your own. In this tutorial notebook, it is shown how to use this to optimize a quantity that depends on a combination of an inferred quantity and one of the inputs.


## Imports

```{python}
from typing import Literal

import bofire.strategies.api as strategies
from bofire.benchmarks.api import Himmelblau
from bofire.data_models.strategies.api import Scalarization, SoboStrategy
from bofire.utils.torch_tools import get_additive_botorch_objective
```

## Define the scalarization

A scalarization consists of a data model, which makes it serializable, and a function that maps it to a callable for BoTorch. The callable receives the sampled output values (`samples`, outputs in the order of `domain.outputs`) and the corresponding inputs `X`, transformed for the model, and returns one value per sample to maximize.

For the optimization, we want to subtract the value of feature `x_1` from the objective of the inferred quantity. `penalty` is a parameter of the scalarization, stored with the strategy.

```{python}
class InputPenaltyScalarization(Scalarization):
    """Subtracts `penalty` times an input from the sum of the objectives."""

    type: Literal["InputPenaltyScalarization"] = "InputPenaltyScalarization"
    feature: str
    penalty: float = 1.0


@strategies.register_scalarization(InputPenaltyScalarization)
def map_input_penalty(data_model, domain, experiments, input_preprocessing_specs):
    # the column of the input in the tensor `X`
    feature2index, _ = domain.inputs._get_transform_info(input_preprocessing_specs)
    feat_idx = feature2index[data_model.feature][0]
    objective = get_additive_botorch_objective(
        outputs=domain.outputs, experiments=experiments
    )

    def f(samples, X):
        return objective(samples, X) - data_model.penalty * X[..., feat_idx]

    return f
```

## Run the optimization

```{python}
benchmark = Himmelblau()
experiments = benchmark.f(benchmark.domain.inputs.sample(10), return_complete=True)

strategy_data = SoboStrategy(
    domain=benchmark.domain,
    scalarization=InputPenaltyScalarization(feature="x_1"),
)
strategy = strategies.map(strategy_data)
strategy.tell(experiments)
strategy.ask(1)
```

The data model, including the scalarization, can be serialized and loaded again like any other strategy, once the scalarization is registered.

```{python}
SoboStrategy.model_validate_json(strategy_data.model_dump_json())
```
